top_choice_rationale: P001 gives a clean two-name credit (Katori, Ye) for an instrument that opened a new regime: neutral atoms in a magic-wavelength lattice interrogated free of Doppler and recoil shifts at 10^-18, reproduced across independent laboratories and distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-quantum-system citations if the citation names the lattice. Original idea, first demonstrations and verification can all be stated. P002 is the more exciting physics but I am not absolutely sure of the original experimental credit (Yuan Cao's role in 2018) or of maturity, so it ranks second; a prize this year is still better than none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no collaboration with Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer. Chalmers/Gothenburg proximity to Johansson and Mehlig is institutional only.
